woe.text: Ashiok arrives on Eldraine to profit from the Wicked Slumber, and in the Court of the Ardent Queen, Ashiok greets Rowan Kenrith and leads her to Eriette, who reanimates the sleepers as her court in Ardenvale.
Ashiok conjures an illusion of Rowan's parents and tells her that her spark is gone, and Eriette welcomes Rowan as her heir.

Ashiok turns the sleepers' nightmares against the awake and takes control of the sleepers in battle against Will's knights, until Kellan lashes Ashiok in place so that Will can strike them with a bolt of ice, forcing them to planeswalk away.
